# Load Data

```{r}


source_path <- 'Z:/prix_electricite_gitlab/VAR_analysis_fr/auxiliary'
setwd(source_path)
source("hd_aux_log.R")


library(slider)
save_rds_path_hd <- "Z:/prix_electricite_gitlab/VAR_analysis_fr/VAR_output/plot_irfs_rds/1var/hd"

historical_decomp_iv_tibo <- readRDS( "hd_iv_log.rds")

#historical_decomp_iv_tibo <- historical_decomp_iv_tibo[, , c(2, 1)]
hd_cholesky <- readRDS( "hd_chol_log.rds")

vars <- vars_demand
mean_vector <- colMeans(vars_demand, na.rm = TRUE)
vars_demeaned <- sweep(vars_demand, 2, mean_vector, "-")
vars_demand_reconstructed <- sweep(vars_demeaned, 2, mean_vector, "+")
n_vars_demand <- ncol(vars_demand)
IV_data_log_esp <- IV_data_log_esp %>% 
  mutate(
    HICP_log_diff = HICP_log - lag(HICP_log),
    HICP_log_diff = replace_na(HICP_log_diff, 0)
  )

vars_demand<- ts(IV_data_log_esp[, c(headers_var_gen_first_mp_gas)], frequency=12)

p = 12     
irhor = 40
x_demand =ts(vars_demand , start=c(2015,1), end=c(2025,9), frequency=12)
y =vars_demand[-1:-p, ]
T = nrow(y)
#variables dans VAR
#nbre de variables instrumentees
k <- 1
#nbre d'instruments
l <- 1

# Fit the VAR model
vl_demand <- if (is.null(controls)) {
  vars::VAR(x_demand, p, type = "const")
} else {
  vars::VAR(x_demand, p, type = "const", exogen = controls)
}
coef = coef(vl_demand)
bet = do.call(cbind, lapply(1:n, function(x) coef[[x]][,1]))
res_demand = residuals(vl_demand)
n_obs <- nrow(res_demand)
```

# Historical Decomposition

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
dates_formatted <- as.yearmon(time(x_demand))
dates_formatted <- dates_formatted[(p+1):length(dates_formatted)]
str(dates_formatted)
colors_shock <- c(  "purple", "yellow",  "blue", "green", "red", "orange", "pink")
names <- c( "Load" ,"$P_{elec}$", "Generation", 
            "IPI",  "$HICP$", "ECB rate","$P_{gas}$")

theta_0 <- matrix(rnorm(10, 0, 1), ncol=2, nrow= 5)
irf_response_test <- as.data.frame(theta_0)
irf_response_test$shock <- rep(names, length.out = length(theta_0[,1]))
irf_response_test$shock <- factor(irf_response_test$shock, levels = names)
# fake plot just to construct the correct legend
dates_formatted <- as.yearmon(time(x_demand))
#dates_formatted <- dates_formatted[(p+1):length(dates_formatted)]
# Format to shorter labels (e.g., "May 15", "Jun 15", ...)


plot_legend <- ggplot(data =irf_response_test, aes(x=V1, fill = shock))+
  geom_histogram()+
  theme( legend.direction = "horizontal")+
scale_fill_manual(
  values = colors_shock,
  labels = TeX(names))
# Légende personnalisée (à ajuster selon vos besoins)
custom_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(plot_legend)

```

La différence qui existe entre ma série et la série reconstruite
correspond à l'approximation de la limite des horizons.
Lorsque pour une Cholesky, on calcule de plus en plus d'horizons,
la différence entre les deux courbes se réduit
En plus, il y avait la dérive intuitée par Giovanni.

```{r}
      expression(pi)

plot_ne_iv_all <- function(
    specification = 'Including Gas',
    price_scale = 1000,
    root = 'Z:/prix_electricite_gitlab') {
  model_file <- file.path(root, 'VAR_analysis_fr', 'VAR_output',
    'plot_irfs_rds', '1var', 'hd',
    'hd_supply_demand_with_without_gas.rds')
  data_file <- file.path(root, 'VAR_analysis_fr', 'VAR_output',
    'IV_data_esp_log_elas_sd_2026.parquet')
  pipeline_models <- readRDS(model_file)
  if (!specification %in% names(pipeline_models))
    stop('Unknown specification: ', specification)
  model <- pipeline_models[[specification]]
  variable <- 'HICP_log'
  pipeline_data <- arrow::read_parquet(data_file) |>
    dplyr::arrange(observation_date)

  contribution_data <- as.data.frame(
    model[['hd']][, variable, c('Supply', 'Demand'), drop = FALSE][, 1, ]
  ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Date = as.Date(model[['dates']])) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c('Supply', 'Demand'),
      names_to = 'Shock', values_to = 'Monthly_contribution') |>
    dplyr::group_by(Shock) |>
    dplyr::arrange(Date, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Contribution = slider::slide_dbl(
      Monthly_contribution, sum, .before = 11, .complete = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  observed_data <- pipeline_data |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      Date = as.Date(observation_date),
      Inflation_12m = HICP_log - dplyr::lag(HICP_log, 12),
      Electricity_price = exp(spot_price_log),
      Price_scaled = (Electricity_price -
        mean(Electricity_price, na.rm = TRUE)) / price_scale) |>
    dplyr::filter(Date %in% model[['dates']])

  ggplot() +
    geom_col(data = contribution_data,
      aes(Date, Contribution, fill = Shock),
      position = 'stack', width = 25, na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_line(data = observed_data,
      aes(Date, Inflation_12m, color = 'Inflation'),
      linewidth = 0.7, linetype = 'dashed', na.rm = TRUE) +
    geom_line(data = observed_data,
      aes(Date, Price_scaled, color = 'Electricity price'),
      linewidth = 0.7, linetype = 'dashed', na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Supply = 'blue', Demand = 'red'),
      breaks = c('Supply', 'Demand'), name = NULL) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(Inflation = 'black',
      'Electricity price' = 'darkgoldenrod'), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = '12-month HICP contribution (log-points)',
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * price_scale,
        name = 'Electricity price deviation (euros)')) +
    labs(title = specification, x = 'Time') +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = 'top',
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
}

# Benchmark plot, fully aligned with the contribution pipeline.
ne_iv_all <- plot_ne_iv_all('Including Gas')
ne_iv_all

```

Describing the summation Error

```{r}
series = 4
data <- data.frame(
  x = dates_formatted,
  y = vars_demand_demeaned[5:nrow(vars_demand_demeaned),series],
  ytest = apply(historical_decomp_matrix[,series,, drop = FALSE], 1, sum)
)


ggplot(data, aes(x = x)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = y, color = "Actual")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = ytest, color = "Decomposition")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = y- ytest, color = "Error")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "blue", 
                                "Decomposition" = "red",
                                "Error"="black")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("Decomposition of", series, "using historical data"),
       x = "Date",
       y = "Value") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

Montrer le terme de dérive lorsqu'on fait tourner la VAR sans erreurs


```{r}


ggplot() +
  geom_line(mapping= aes(x= dates_formatted, 
                         y = reconstruct_derive_without_errors_ter[,series][c(-1:-p)], color = "Derive"))+
  geom_line(data=data, mapping=aes(x = x, y = y - ytest, color = "Error")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Derive" = "blue", 
                                "Decomposition" = "red",
                                "Error"="black")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = paste("Decomposition of", series, "using historical data"),
       x = "Date",
       y = "Value") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
